job.title: SAP EWM Consultant
job.description:
SAP EWM Senior Consultant - 7 month initial contract - Hybrid - English and Portuguese

 

We are looking for an experienced SAP EWM Senior Consultant to support a global manufacturing end client with its SAP S/4HANA rollout in Portugal.

 

Key details:

  • Start: ASAP
  • Location: Hybrid, with on-site attendance once or twice a month in East Portugal
  • Languages: English required; Portuguese is an advantage.

 

Expected responsibilities:

  • Coordinate the local EWM team while providing hands-on functional expertise.
  • Review existing warehouse processes and deliver configuration and system preparation in line with the global core model.
  • Produce functional specification documents for agreed localisation requirements.
  • Support EWM data migration from the existing non-SAP system, including bins, stock, control cycles and packaging instructions.
  • Work with local users on testing, training and operational readiness.
  • Collaborate with the wider programme team on cutover, go-live and hypercare.

 

What we’re looking for:

  • Strong hands-on SAP EWM functional and configuration experience.
  • Experience delivering SAP S/4HANA implementations or rollouts.
  • Experience with EWM data migration and functional specifications.
  • A good understanding of warehouse operations and integration with wider SAP logistics processes.
  • Clear communication with warehouse users and international project teams, with the ability to manage local requirements within an established core model.

 

You’ll be supported by a capable, engaged plant team and dedicated change management support.

 

If you’re interested, please send your latest CV, availability and expected daily rate.

  • Lead the optimisation, design and implementation of accounting processes within SAP S/4HANA, ensuring alignment with the Group's Core Model. Identify opportunities to leverage new SAP functionalities, implement accounting best practices and recommend improvements to systems and processes.
  • Act as the primary point of contact for Key Users within the assigned scope, working closely with SAP experts, the Finance Lead, the Controlling BPO, the implementation partner, Finance Management and Shared Service Centre (SSC) teams.
  • Ensure adherence to the defined Core Model, support end-user training and facilitate the adoption of the new SAP S/4HANA solution and associated finance processes across the organisation.
  • Organise and oversee user acceptance testing, ensuring the solution meets business requirements and project objectives. Provide functional expertise throughout deployment, go-live and post-go-live support.
  • 10+ years of experience implementing SAP FI, ideally across both ECC 6.0 and SAP S/4HANA, with strong knowledge of multi-ledger accounting, treasury and fixed assets. Proven ability to design, redefine and implement accounting processes within a complex, international environment.
